blind.description: A triangular pyramid stack of six stylized red gunpowder barrels arranged 3-2-1, supported at the base edges by two wooden wedges/chocks. A coiled dark brown rope or fuse sits atop the uppermost barrel. Each barrel features bright red main body staves, light wood-grain hoops and rim ends, and black flame stencils on the front circular ends. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: Shows the horizontal cylindrical profile of the topmost red wooden barrel with tan rims, topped by a circular coiled dark brown rope fuse, with the side edges of the lower barrels and chocks protruding slightly on either side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the figure (approximately 2.3 to 2.5 feet tall) and roughly 2.5 feet wide across the base.
